concerns.text: Phase 7 (Contracts & Validation) introduces JSON‑Schema contracts, unit‑test validation, and linting steps that are not referenced by any Functional Requirement (FR‑001 – FR‑012) or Success Criterion (SC‑001 – SC‑005) in the spec. This constitutes plan over‑reach; either a corresponding FR/SC should be added to the spec or the phase should be removed/merged into an existing requirement.
